UPSC 2028 Strategy From November – Complete Roadmap for Beginners! If you are planning to start your UPSC Civil Services Examination (CSE) preparation from November and aim to become an IAS or IPS officer, this video will help you understand how to begin your journey with the right strategy.

In this video, we discuss a complete UPSC 2028 preparation roadmap, including how to start from zero, how to divide your preparation into manageable phases, and how to balance Prelims, Mains and Interview preparation. Learn how to build strong fundamentals, choose the right study resources, develop a consistent study routine, and avoid common mistakes made by beginners.

• UPSC 2028 preparation strategy from November
• Complete roadmap for beginners starting from zero
• UPSC syllabus and exam pattern overview
• NCERT and basic book preparation strategy
• Current affairs and newspaper reading approach
• Prelims MCQ practice and revision planning
• Mains answer writing and optional subject planning
• Study timetable and daily preparation targets
• Mock tests, revision cycles and progress tracking
• Common mistakes UPSC aspirants should avoid

Starting early can help you build a stronger foundation, revise systematically, and prepare for both Prelims and Mains in a structured way. Remember, the right strategy depends on your current preparation level, available study hours, and consistency.

Watch the complete video, make your own preparation plan, and start working towards your UPSC CSE 2028 goal. Subscribe for more UPSC strategy sessions, preparation guidance, study plans, current affairs and exam-oriented learning.
